official: 八王子市歴史・郷土ミュージアム条例の一部を改正する条例設定について
name: 資料の管理方針と施設料金の電子決済を追加
summary: これまでは、資料の収集・管理方針を定めることや、予約用の電子システムを通じて貸出料金を支払うことは条例に定められていませんでした。改正後は、資料の収集・管理方針を定めて運用する事業を加え、その方針の策定は指定管理者の業務から除きます。また、予約用の電子システムを通じた貸出料金の支払いを認め、その支払いを利用承認とみなします。
changes: 資料の収集・管理方針を定め、適切に運用する事業を加える
資料の収集・管理方針の策定を指定管理者の業務から除く
予約用の電子システムを通じた貸出料金の支払いを認める
電子システムを通じた貸出料金の支払いを利用承認とみなす
who: 体験展示室などの施設を利用する人

en.name: Adds a materials collection and management policy and electronic payment of rental fees
en.official: On Establishing an Ordinance Partially Amending the Hachioji City History and Local Heritage Museum Ordinance
en.summary: Until now, the Ordinance did not set out a policy for collecting and managing materials or payment of rental fees through the electronic reservation system. The amendments add an activity to establish and appropriately implement a policy for collecting and managing materials, while excluding the formulation of that policy from the designated manager’s duties. They also allow rental fees to be paid through the electronic reservation system and treat that payment as approval to use the facility.
changes: Adds an activity to establish and appropriately implement a policy for collecting and managing materials
Excludes formulating the materials collection and management policy from the designated manager’s duties
Allows rental fees to be paid through the electronic reservation system
Treats rental fee payments made through the electronic system as approval to use the facility
who: People paying rental fees through the electronic reservation system
People using facilities such as the hands-on exhibition room
